CustomField.description: API name of the Named Credential for the bucket (for S3: URL https://BUCKET.s3.REGION.amazonaws.com, AWS Signature Version 4 external credential with a read-only access key). The key itself is entered in Setup and never stored on this record or in code.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The API name of the Named Credential that connects to the bucket, for example Trade_View_S3.
CustomField.label: Named Credential
